shapeSummary: Flat rectangular PCB 20.32 x 1.6 x 17.78 mm (thickness along Y, bottom at Y=0) with two 3.4 mm through holes, a row of five 1 mm pin holes at 2.54 mm pitch along the +X edge, and a simple 3x3x1 mm block representing the sensor IC at the center on top.
warnings: Board length/width come from unverified metadata; the 1.6 mm thickness is assumed.

The IC is a simplified 3x3x1 mm block; the small passives, pins, and markings are omitted.
